_note: Metadata for the token koha settles in. The ACTIVE token's address lives in addresses.json under SettlementToken, which stays the single source of truth. Chain-id keys describe the active token; `candidates` records tokens that have been verified on-chain but cannot settle on the rail yet. dNZD's metadata below is confirmed by read-only calls (docs/DNZD.md) — its status is pending because it does not implement EIP-3009, which x402's exact-EVM scheme requires.

dNZD.blocker: No EIP-3009. transferWithAuthorization and receiveWithAuthorization are absent in both signature forms, confirmed by exhaustive selector enumeration and behavioural probes. x402's exact-EVM scheme settles by calling transferWithAuthorization on the asset, so dNZD cannot settle over x402. ERC-2612 permit is implemented and verified, but permit only grants an allowance — it does not move tokens gaslessly, so it is not a substitute. Suite itself holds dNZD fine; only the x402 payment leg is blocked. See docs/DNZD.md.
